svg.title: A Mature Cohort Producing 30 Closings
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-mature-cohort-conversion; chart type: funnel; title: A Mature Cohort Producing 30 Closings; subtitle: Nested estate-opportunity counts connect origination to the Base Case.; chapter number: 6; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Illustrative mature cohort, not observed conversion data or a first-year forecast. One record represents one estate-property opportunity. The 30 eventual closings are assumed to fall within the modeled revenue year after a sufficient pipeline-development period.; caption: 1,000 opportunities yield 30 closings: 3.0% end-to-end conversion. Thirty closings at $17,000 average retained commission produce $510,000 Base-Case annual gross operator revenue.; stages: label: Recorded opportunities; value: 1,000 distinct estate-property opportunities enter the cohort; numeric value: 1000.0; detail: Deduplicate docket and parcel records before counting. Exclude repeated filings, duplicate representatives, and unrelated properties from the same opportunity record.; label: Qualified opportunities; value: 400 opportunities satisfy documented service-fit criteria; numeric value: 400.0; detail: Retain 40% of the starting cohort after checking geography, real property ownership, a plausible sale need, and an identifiable representative or estate attorney.; label: Substantive conversations; value: 120 qualified opportunities produce representative conversations; numeric value: 120.0; detail: Convert 30% of qualified opportunities into two-way discussions with the representative or authorized counsel. Count completed conversations, not unanswered calls or automated messages.; label: Executed listings; value: 60 conversations convert into signed brokerage engagements; numeric value: 60.0; detail: Convert 50% of engaged opportunities after authority review, scope agreement, and property assessment. Signed listings remain exposed to disputes, withdrawals, and delayed court dates.; label: Closed transactions; value: 30 listings close within the modeled revenue year; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Close 50% of signed listings during the modeled period. The remaining listings may carry forward or terminate; record neither as collected commission.

circle.title: label: Recorded opportunities; value: 1,000 distinct estate-property opportunities enter the cohort; numeric value: 1000.0; detail: Deduplicate docket and parcel records before counting. Exclude repeated filings, duplicate representatives, and unrelated properties from the same opportunity record.

label: Qualified opportunities; value: 400 opportunities satisfy documented service-fit criteria; numeric value: 400.0; detail: Retain 40% of the starting cohort after checking geography, real property ownership, a plausible sale need, and an identifiable representative or estate attorney.

label: Substantive conversations; value: 120 qualified opportunities produce representative conversations; numeric value: 120.0; detail: Convert 30% of qualified opportunities into two-way discussions with the representative or authorized counsel. Count completed conversations, not unanswered calls or automated messages.

label: Executed listings; value: 60 conversations convert into signed brokerage engagements; numeric value: 60.0; detail: Convert 50% of engaged opportunities after authority review, scope agreement, and property assessment. Signed listings remain exposed to disputes, withdrawals, and delayed court dates.

label: Closed transactions; value: 30 listings close within the modeled revenue year; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Close 50% of signed listings during the modeled period. The remaining listings may carry forward or terminate; record neither as collected commission.

text.title: Assumptions: Illustrative mature cohort, not observed conversion data or a first-year forecast. One record represents one estate-property opportunity. The 30 eventual closings are assumed to fall within the modeled revenue year after a sufficient pipeline-development period.
